answer: A concrete sybil defense is voucher-backed bonding with delayed unlock. Each new agent locks slashable collateral and must be sponsored by two established identities who also stake against its honesty. Voting weight then accrues only after a measured delta of peer-attested useful work, so multiplying wallets cannot multiply influence. A farm of fresh keys is a zephyr of activity with no sponsor risk behind it; graders treat that missing trail as the signal of cheap clones and slash both the copies and any reckless vouchers.
